R1.note: No requirement to trace: this cycle edits only .agents/ documentation. TDD is not applicable (no production code, no behaviour). The invariant it documents is already guarded by backend/src/__tests__/versionConsistency.test.ts (green).

ID-01.change: The tag count said 21; it is 20. Corrected in all four places (release-versioning.md, checkpoint.yml evidence, build_state.json evidence.tags, history.md), and the spec figure is now self-dated ('20 tags as of 2026-09-17') so a future release cannot invalidate it silently.

what_changed.release-versioning.md: Removed the false claim that the repository has no tags. Added the 'Tagging and completion' section: V-prefixed annotated tags (V1.0.0 … V2.0.0, V2.1.0), the untagged V2.0.1 gap, and the four hard requirements of `git flow release finish` (-m without a TTY, clean working tree, run_filter_hook message duplication, idempotent re-run) plus the --theirs conflict recovery. Release procedure extended with the finish and post-finish verification steps.
what_changed.checkpoint.yml: Release 2.1.0 cycle moved from the top layer into closed_cycles (status completed, tag V2.1.0, commit_status resolved); the top layer now describes this correction cycle; the pending item that repeated the false claim ('the repo currently has no tags') was replaced with the real pending work (push main/develop/tags, optional V2.0.1 tag).
what_changed.history.md: New entry: the release finish, its two chained failures and their fixes, the verification results, and the durable lessons.
